pr_title: Bluetooth: Controller: Add hdl checks in isoal.c
pr_body:
Add checks to verify the `hdl` parameters before accessing the sink and source arrays.

fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/58965
fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/59510
